title: Cellar Society Wine Dinner
seo_title: Cellar Society Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO – Dec 7
description: The Cellar Society Wine Dinner is a holiday-themed evening of food with wine pairings, plus an optional Ugly Christmas Sweater Contest and karaoke after dinner. Tickets are $75, and reservations are required by calling (417) 882-0399 or reserving online. It takes place Monday, December 7, 2026 at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO, with happy hour at 6 PM and dinner at 7 PM.
